premise: I used my $125,000 401(k) to launch an in-home senior-care franchise with my brother-in-law, securing a signed 40% stake and a paid coordinator job, but after a national chain offered a $900,000 buyout he forged an ownership release, sold the franchise, and handed me a $5,000 “severance”; I found the original partnership notarized on a birthday card from my late husband, voided the sale, and now run “Careless Betrayal Senior Services,” where he has to change bedpans in a scrub shirt that reads “Dependable Liar” and every welcome kit prints his fraud docket number.
